title: Mixed Event — A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?! — Episode1 Think of a Surprise

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!
meta.Event Outline: Not long before White Day, Tsukasa is set to perform as an extra at a facility where visitors can make their own chocolates. Meanwhile, Mizuki has come up with plans for White Day return gifts, and invites Akito along for some chocolate making.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Great work today, everyone!
Let's do the same tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah! See you then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Building that huge prop today was so much fun! I can't wait to show Miku and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm?
Tsukasa and KAITO seem really worried about something. What could be bothering them so much?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey!
Everything okay, you guys?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Len, I take it you're done working on that prop? Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The plushies and I had a lot of fun with that! But more importantly, is something wrong? You guys seem pretty concerned about something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I was just asking Tsukasa about this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Asking him about what...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About... White Day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: White Day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. For Valentine's Day, Saki, Emu and the others presented me with such spectacular cakes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I'll need to give something extra special in return for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
That sounds like something a star who can make everyone smile like you should do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly!
But the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm not sure what to get...
I've tried so hard, but I'm not getting any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're kidding, right? You're Tsukasa Tenma! Just give her a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's already in the works!
I'll be inviting Emu and the others to my house for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I also want to surprise them with something that's truly special besides just a show! Something that'll really move them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something special other than a show, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Their Valentine's Day presents must've been really something if you're getting this worked up about it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I have to agree.
Why don't we keep trying to think of something truly special for just a little bit longer...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll help too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You will?! Thank you, Len, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's get right to it...
Besides a show, what would make a good gift?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
What about sweets or flowers?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I already suggested those things, but Tsukasa seems to want something more special or grandiose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What would really wow Saki, Emu and the others...? Hmm... They're usually happy about any gifts they receive, which actually makes this even harder...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, what if you surprised them somehow during your show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
During the show?
How?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As it happens, we'll also be surprising Miku and the others with a show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The story involves us building a gingerbread house, and we'll be inviting all of them into that house as a surprise at the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds incredible!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. And just today, the plushies and I were working on that very house! But that's just between us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Roger!
Still...
A surprise within a show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If a surprise proves too challenging, you can always present everyone with a gift through your show. For example, we'll be giving each of our guests their own gingerbread house.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...!
That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show will be a spin-off of Pegasus Odyssey where the prince goes on a quest to search for Pegasus... A surprise involving that would be...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...!
What if I appeared before Saki and everyone else during the final scene as a shining Pegasus?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Having to also play Pegasus off the cuff may prove a bit difficult...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, what if you presented them with the sword from Pegasus Odyssey at the end?! That thing's so cool because it looks real!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Emu would certainly enjoy that, but I'm not sure Saki would...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's true... Alright, what if my quest took me to a field of a thousand roses...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... We've come up with plenty of ideas, but none of them seem like the right answer...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, trying to please everyone is no easy task.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed... However, you both gave me the idea of presenting a gift related to our show, so I need to thank you for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'll have to leave this for another day. I should get going soon...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? You're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I have a gig this weekend and need to remain in good condition for it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A gig?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rui mentioned before that you work as an extra sometimes while your stage undergoes maintenance and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's work that's reserved for those with acting experience! That even includes some opportunities to be a full-cast member instead of just an extra!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds interesting.
What will you be doing this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be performing at the “Chocolate Factory” that just recently opened!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The Chocolate Factory...?
As in an actual factory for making chocolate?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're performing at a factory?
That seems kinda strange.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, after doing some research, I found that it's also partly a museum.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A place where people can learn about the history of chocolate, compare different kinds of chocolate and even make their own tasty treats!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! That sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But what does a show there involve?
Mind telling us more after you're finished with your performance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll be off.
Thank you both again for your advice! I'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We talked a lot and came up with some ideas, but none of them really seemed to work.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How can we help Tsukasa? Isn't there a good idea out there that he can use...?
